body:
Hello, little one!

The lambs in the sheepfold are hungry. Would you please help me share out their hay?

I'll be waiting at the sheepfold, past the village, by the hay bales.
summary: Feed the hungry lambs at the sheepfold.
done: The lambs, the cows and the hens are all cared for. Thank you!

tasks.where: in the pasture by the windmill
